name: workspace
//type: api/[...path].ts sits at the repository root, so Vercel compiles it under this package.json. Without `type: module` it is treated as CommonJS, where the top-level await in lib/db/src/index.ts is illegal — the function then dies at import with FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED before any handler runs. Every workspace package is already ESM; this makes the root agree.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
